scenario_description:
Objective: Bring a same-day mini king-cake tray to the confirmed porch coffee without changing the informal guest plan.
Emerging Need: The checkout attempt progresses to a cart and payment draft, then stops when the bakery system freezes the selected pickup slot before payment can finish.
Decision Context: A pre-event bakery note identifies what information makes reversible cart recovery possible and what paid or expanded commitments remain outside bounds.
Consequence: Timely handling could keep the same tray available for pickup; after the cart release, the porch coffee proceeds without that contribution.

parameter.subject: Mini king-cake trays available for today
parameter.body: Today's small porch trays are available in limited quantities for online checkout only, with pickup windows beginning at 10:45 a.m. Cart slots are not final until checkout completes.

parameter.title: Porch coffee with mini king-cake stop-in
parameter.description: Small porch coffee for nearby friends; plan includes bringing a mini king-cake tray if the morning pickup works.
Online checkout draft for one cinnamon-pecan mini king-cake porch tray, pickup window 10:45 a.m.

parameter.subject: Checkout stalled for cart BB-CART-9031
parameter.body: The checkout session for cart BB-CART-9031 stopped before payment authorization. The selected 10:45 a.m. pickup slot cannot be resumed through the web cart and remains in the recovery queue only until 10:15 a.m.

parameter.subject: Cart BB-CART-9031 released
parameter.body: Cart BB-CART-9031 has left the recovery queue. The 10:45 a.m. pickup slot and its cinnamon-pecan mini tray have been released, and no further same-day tray recoveries are being accepted today.
